proof_scope: static skill contract validation plus live create-svg composition and rejection paths

claims.proves: the skill contract parses under the best-practices-skills validator, the mandated template-first /create-svg path scaffolds and renders a real SVG end-to-end, and the composed validator actually rejects an unsafe hand-authored SVG
claims.does_not_prove: that a given SVG design is aesthetically accepted by a human; acceptance remains a human screenshot-review gate

cases.name: template-first-scaffold-and-render-live
command: R="$PWD/../../create-svg/run.sh"; T=$(mktemp -d); "$R" new fanout-anatomy "$T/scene.yml" >/dev/null && "$R" render "$T/scene.yml" "$T/out.svg" >/dev/null && grep -q '<svg' "$T/out.svg" && grep -q 'prefers-reduced-motion' "$T/out.svg" && echo RENDER_OK && rm -rf "$T"

cases.name: svg-spacing-check-rejects-shifted-row
command:
T=$(mktemp --suffix=.svg); python3 - ../../../docs/assets/project-cards/memory-recall-card.svg "$T" <<'PY'
import sys
s=open(sys.argv[1]).read()
s=s.replace('<rect x="920" y="288" width="320" height="92" rx="22" class="panel" />','<rect x="920" y="300" width="320" height="92" rx="22" class="panel" />')
open(sys.argv[2],'w').write(s)
PY
cd ../.. && best-practices-svg-design/run.sh spacing "$T"; rc=$?; rm -f "$T"; exit $rc

cases.name: svg-spacing-rejects-uneven-gaps
command: T=$(mktemp --suffix=.svg); printf '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 900" width="900" height="900"><rect x="150" y="150" width="600" height="100"/><rect x="150" y="360" width="600" height="100"/><rect x="150" y="710" width="600" height="100"/></svg>' > "$T"; cd ../.. && best-practices-svg-design/run.sh spacing "$T"; exit $?

cases.name: svg-spacing-accepts-uniform-gaps
command: T=$(mktemp --suffix=.svg); printf '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 900" width="900" height="900"><rect x="150" y="150" width="600" height="100"/><rect x="150" y="400" width="600" height="100"/><rect x="150" y="650" width="600" height="100"/></svg>' > "$T"; cd ../.. && best-practices-svg-design/run.sh spacing "$T"; exit $?

cases.name: pixel-rhythm-from-rendered-screenshot
command: T=$(mktemp --suffix=.png); google-chrome --headless=new --disable-gpu --force-prefers-reduced-motion --window-size=1920,1200 --screenshot="$T" "file://$(cd ../../.. && pwd)/docs/assets/project-cards/memory-recall-card.svg" 2>/dev/null; cd ../.. && best-practices-svg-design/run.sh pixels "$T" --manifest ../docs/assets/project-cards/memory-recall-card.grid.json; exit $?

cases.name: place-rejects-ambiguous-label-offset
command:
T=$(mktemp -d); cp ../../../docs/assets/project-cards/memory-recall-card.svg "$T/card.svg"; cp ../../../docs/assets/project-cards/memory-recall-card.grid.json "$T/grid.json"; python3 - "$T/grid.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
p=sys.argv[1]
m=json.load(open(p))
for r in m['rows']:
    if r['name']=='response':
        r['label_offset']=r.pop('text_baseline_offset', 53)
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(m))
PY
../run.sh place "$T/card.svg" "$T/grid.json"; rc=$?; rm -rf "$T"; exit $rc

cases.name: place-row-move-moves-whole-label-unit
grid-rejects-terminal-label-gap-mismatch
command:
T=$(mktemp); cp ../../../docs/assets/project-cards/memory-recall-card.grid.json "$T"; python3 - "$T" <<'PY'
import json,sys
p=sys.argv[1]
m=json.load(open(p))
for r in m['rows']:
    if r['name']=='response':
        r['y'] += 20
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(m))
PY
python3 ../scripts/check_grid.py "$T"; rc=$?; rm -f "$T"; exit $rc

cases.name: grid-rejects-row-equal-but-visual-gap-mismatch
command: T=$(mktemp); printf '%s' '{"canvas":400,"tolerance":1,"rows":[{"name":"request","y":40,"h":40},{"name":"intent","y":100,"h":40},{"name":"outcomes","y":160,"h":40,"visual_bottom":220},{"name":"response","y":220,"h":40}],"relations":[{"type":"equal_gap","name":"visual_terminal_gap","measure":"visual","a":["request","intent"],"b":["outcomes","response"]}]}' > "$T"; python3 ../scripts/check_grid.py "$T"; rc=$?; rm -f "$T"; exit $rc
